savings_accounts_opening_cost.name: savings_accounts_opening_cost
savings_accounts_opening_cost.value: "savings_accounts"."opening_cost" is null or ("savings_accounts"."kind" = 'investment' and "savings_accounts"."opening_cost" between 0 and 100000000)

savings_accounts_monthly_plan.name: savings_accounts_monthly_plan
savings_accounts_monthly_plan.value: "savings_accounts"."monthly_plan" is null or ("savings_accounts"."kind" <> 'credit' and "savings_accounts"."monthly_plan" between 1 and 100000000)

savings_accounts_target_amount.name: savings_accounts_target_amount
savings_accounts_target_amount.value: "savings_accounts"."target_amount" is null or ("savings_accounts"."kind" <> 'credit' and "savings_accounts"."target_amount" between 1 and 100000000)

savings_accounts_due_day.name: savings_accounts_due_day
savings_accounts_due_day.value: "savings_accounts"."due_day" is null or ("savings_accounts"."kind" = 'credit' and "savings_accounts"."due_day" between 1 and 31)

savings_accounts_statement_day.name: savings_accounts_statement_day
savings_accounts_statement_day.value: "savings_accounts"."statement_day" is null or ("savings_accounts"."kind" = 'credit' and "savings_accounts"."statement_day" between 1 and 31)

savings_categories_budget.name: savings_categories_budget
savings_categories_budget.value: "savings_categories"."monthly_budget" is null or ("savings_categories"."kind" = 'expense' and "savings_categories"."monthly_budget" between 1 and 100000000)

savings_recurring_counter.name: savings_recurring_counter
savings_recurring_counter.value: ("savings_recurring"."kind" = 'transfer') = ("savings_recurring"."counter_account_id" is not null) and ("savings_recurring"."counter_account_id" is null or "savings_recurring"."counter_account_id" <> "savings_recurring"."account_id")

savings_transactions_amount.name: savings_transactions_amount
savings_transactions_amount.value: case when "savings_transactions"."kind" = 'adjust' then "savings_transactions"."amount" <> 0 and "savings_transactions"."amount" between -100000000 and 100000000 else "savings_transactions"."amount" between 1 and 100000000 end

savings_transactions_counter.name: savings_transactions_counter
savings_transactions_counter.value: ("savings_transactions"."kind" = 'transfer') = ("savings_transactions"."counter_account_id" is not null) and ("savings_transactions"."counter_account_id" is null or "savings_transactions"."counter_account_id" <> "savings_transactions"."account_id")
